welcome.title: A neighbourhood café that feels like yours.
welcome.script: pull up a chair, stay a while
paragraphs: Brew & Leaf is a small café for students between classes, people working nearby and families out for the weekend. We roast our coffee to order, bake through the morning and keep the menu short so everything on it is good.
Come for a quick espresso, stay for lunch, or bring your laptop - there's fast Wi-Fi and plenty of plugs.

faq.q: Do I need to book a table?
faq.a: Walk-ins are always welcome. On weekend mornings and evenings it gets busy, so booking guarantees you a table - it takes a minute on our booking page.
Yes - two-wheeler parking right outside, and a pay-and-park two minutes' walk away.

faq.q: Can I work from the café?
faq.a: Of course. We have fast Wi-Fi, plug points at most tables and a quieter upstairs corner. No minimum order.
Every dish carries a veg, egg or non-veg mark, and vegan, Jain and gluten-free dishes are tagged. Use the filters on the menu page, and tell us about any allergies when you order.
Well-behaved dogs are welcome in our outdoor seating, and we keep a water bowl by the door.

faq.q: Do you take birthday cake or catering orders?
faq.a: Yes - order cakes at least 48 hours ahead and catering for up to 60 people. Message us on WhatsApp or use the contact form.

about.description: How Brew & Leaf Café began in Baner, Pune: small-batch coffee, fresh food made in-house and a café to stay a while.

hero.title: Our story
hero.text: It started with one coffee machine, three tables and a simple idea: make the kind of café we always wanted nearby.

image.alt: The café counter with espresso machine and hanging lights

blocks.title: From three tables to a neighbourhood favourite.
paragraphs: Brew & Leaf opened in 2019 in a small shop on Garden Lane. We wanted somewhere you could get properly good coffee without the fuss, eat something fresh and honest, and sit for as long as you liked.

Word spread among students from the nearby colleges and the IT offices around the corner. Families started coming on weekends. Today we're still the same small team, just with a few more tables - and the same coffee machine.

image.alt: Friends raising cups of coffee over a wooden table

blocks.title: Indian estate beans, roasted for flavour.
paragraphs: Our house blend uses beans from small estates in Chikmagalur and Coorg, roasted in small batches every week. Smooth and chocolatey with milk, bright and clean as an espresso.
Not a coffee person? Ask for our masala chai latte, brewed the slow way with fresh ginger and whole spices.

image.alt: Coffee beans, ground coffee and a latte on a wooden board

items.title: Fresh, not frozen
items.text: Everything is cooked to order or made in-house that morning. Nothing reheated from a packet.

items.title: Local first
items.text: Our milk, bread flour and vegetables come from farms and suppliers around Pune.

items.title: Less waste
items.text: Bring your own cup and get ₹20 off. Leftover bakes go to a local shelter every evening.

items.title: Stay a while
items.text: No rush, no minimum order. A café should be a place to breathe.
